platform: KFAI Fresh Air Community Radio Protected Music Department Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KFAI explicitly invites artists to share music through its Music Department email link, but the address is protected/non-plaintext and the page does not publish file-format, attachment-size, download-link, metadata, release-window or clean-edit requirements. A human must use only the live official contact link, confirm the current address and delivery rules, prepare a rights-cleared pitch and send manually.

platform: WMNF 88.5 FM Public Music Upload Form and Music Relations Email Route
manual_review_reason: WMNF explicitly accepts music through its public upload form and publishes musicrelations@wmnf.org for music email. The form requires artist identity, contact email and audio uploads, accepts up to five files at 50 MB each and supports multiple formats. A human must select suitable rights-cleared files, verify metadata and clean-edit status, inspect the live form for dynamic validation and submit manually.

platform: WPKN 89.5 Protected Music Director and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WPKN explicitly publishes a Music Submission contact for its Music Director and permits physical submissions for library or airplay consideration. The email is protected/non-plaintext and digital file, link and metadata requirements are not published. A human must use the live official contact link or prepare a compliant physical package, confirm rights and release details, and avoid duplicate delivery.

platform: WERU 89.9 FM Public Music Director Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: WERU publicly identifies Denis Howard as Music Director and publishes denis@weru.org, but the current site does not publish an unsolicited-music delivery policy, accepted formats, attachment or download-link rules, release windows or metadata requirements. A human must first send a concise routing inquiry without audio attachments or track links and wait for authorization.

platform: KRCL 90.9 FM Pressed-CD Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KRCL explicitly accepts physical CDs but rejects demos and CD-Rs; submitted copies become station property and are not returned. Its digital upload route is restricted to Utah-based musicians and is not applicable to MarcsMusic. A human must confirm that a professionally pressed CD is available, review the ownership terms, prepare correct release metadata and handle international shipping manually.
